description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Developer based in the United States. 

 We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to build, maintain, and modernize business-critical applications across backend services, frontend interfaces, databases, and cloud environments. In this role, you will work with C#, .NET, React, and modern cloud technologies to deliver reliable, scalable software solutions. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical implementations. From designing APIs and database structures to integrating third-party systems and supporting production applications, you will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle. This opportunity is ideal for a developer who enjoys taking ownership of features, solving complex technical challenges, and improving application performance and development practices.



Accountabilities:
 
 You will contribute to the design, development, deployment, and ongoing improvement of business applications, ensuring they meet operational needs and maintain high standards of reliability, security, and performance.


 
 
 
 Design, develop, and maintain applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, React, and TypeScript.







 
 
 
 Build REST APIs and integrate applications with external business systems through APIs, webhooks, and event-driven workflows.







 
 
 
 Design database schemas, write SQL queries and stored procedures, and optimize database and application performance.







 
 
 
 Implement authentication, role-based authorization, and audit logging to support secure application access.







 
 
 
 Deploy and maintain applications in cloud environments using automated CI/CD pipelines.







 
 
 
 Maintain, troubleshoot, and modernize existing .NET Framework and ASP.NET MVC applications.







 
 
 
 Participate in requirements gathering, architecture discussions, code reviews, testing, and production support.







 
 
 
 Collaborate with business stakeholders and engineering teammates to guide technical decisions and deliver effective solutions.








 Requirements: 

 The ideal candidate brings extensive full stack development experience, strong technical expertise in the Microsoft ecosystem, and the ability to manage features from initial requirements through deployment and ongoing support. You should be comfortable working across frontend and backend technologies while communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


 
 
 
 At least 7 years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience with C# and .NET.







 
 
 
 Strong experience developing backend services using ASP.NET Core and Web API.







 
 
 
 Hands-on experience building frontend applications with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.







 
 
 
 Proficiency with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization.







 
 
 
 Experience integrating third-party APIs and managing asynchronous workflows.







 
 
 
 Experience deploying and supporting applications in Azure or AWS cloud environments.







 
 
 
 Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing practices.







 
 
 
 Ability to take ownership of features from requirements gathering through deployment and production support.







 
 
 
 Strong communication, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.








 Preferred qualifications include:


 
 
 
 Experience with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and legacy ASP.NET MVC applications.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with Entity Framework, LINQ, Redis, and caching strategies.







 
 
 
 Experience with Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Azure Functions, or comparable AWS services.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with microservices, Clean Architecture, domain-driven design, and multi-tenant SaaS applications.







 
 
 
 Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring other developers.







 
 
 
 A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.








 Benefits: 


 
 
 
 Annual compensation ranging from $100,000 to $120,000.







 
 
 
 401(k) plan with employer matching.







 
 
 
 Health, dental, and vision insurance.







 
 
 
 Employee assistance program.







 
 
 
 Employee product discounts.







 
 
 
 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.







 
 
 
 Short-term and long-term disability insurance.







 
 
 
 Employer-paid group life insurance.







 
 
 
 Company-paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).
